Rice Cookies
By: Anonymous
Published: Saturday, February 13, 2010 - 9:41am

Ingredients




cup butter
cup sugar
1 egg
2 cups puffed rice
1 cup flour
1 teaspoon cream of tartar
teaspoon bicarbonate of soda

Preparation

1 Cream together the butter and sugar until pale. 2 Gradually add the beaten egg. 3 Sift flour, cream of tartar, and soda together. 4 Add the puffed rice and flour mixture. blend lightly, Scale teaspoons onto a greased baking tray and bake at 350 F until lightly browned.
